## Checklist
- [ ] Target branch is `dev` (unless this is an approved release PR to `main`)
- [ ] Branch follows `feature/SCRUM-<ID>-<description>` (or documented `fix/` / `test/` type)
- [ ] Related Jira ticket included
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or unrelated code
- [ ] No unintended changes to earlier sprints
- [ ] At least one independent code review before merge
